description: Meta-Env Infrastructure Overview - All Servers, Services, and Projects
title: Infrastructure Overview - Meta-Env
readme:
Meta-Env Infrastructure Overview Dashboard

This dashboard provides a high-level view of the entire infrastructure:

**Network Topology**
- Public IP: 89.203.173.196
- Internal Network: 192.168.1.0/24
- VPN Network: 10.8.0.0/24
- Firewall: Cisco Firepower 1010 (192.168.1.1)

**Server 60 (192.168.1.60) - backup**
- Role: Backup/Dashboard/Monitoring Hub
- OS: Debian 12 (bookworm)
- Web Server: Nginx
- Database: PostgreSQL 15.10
- Services:
  - Grafana (3000)
  - Prometheus (9090)
  - Portainer (9000)
  - OpenVPN Server (1194)
  - Dashboard (8060)
  - Cockpit (10060)

**Server 61 (192.168.1.61) - okamih**
- Role: Production E-commerce
- OS: Debian 13 (trixie)
- Web Server: Apache 2.4.65
- Database: MariaDB 11.8.2
- PHP: 8.4.11 + FPM
- Services:
  - okamih.cz (Czech e-commerce)
  - okamih.sk (Slovak e-commerce)
  - PrestaShop 7/8
  - Prometheus (9090)
  - Cockpit (10061)

**Server 62 (192.168.1.62) - cpall**
- Role: Web Hosting
- OS: Debian 13 (trixie)
- Web Server: Nginx 1.26.3
- Services:
  - Prometheus (9090)
  - Cockpit (10062)
  - HTTP (8062)
  - HTTPS (8462)

**Security Architecture**
- UFW Firewall: Active on all servers
- Default Policy: Deny incoming, Allow outgoing
- OpenVPN: Required for monitoring tools access
- Public Services: Only production web (80, 443) and specific ports
- Monitoring Tools: VPN/Local access ONLY

**Monitoring Stack**
- Prometheus Federation: Central server pulls from all nodes
- Grafana: Unified visualization (Server 60)
- Wazuh: Security monitoring and SIEM
- Node Exporter: System metrics (all servers)
- Application Exporters: Database, web server, custom apps

**Access Methods**
- SSH: Via dedicated ports (2260, 2261, 2262)
- VPN: OpenVPN on Server 60 (10.8.0.0/24)
- Web: Public IPs for production services
- Management: Cockpit on all servers (VPN access)

**Structured Labels**
All metrics use consistent labeling:
- server: server-60, server-61, server-62
- environment: production, development, staging
- project: Project name (okamih-cz, dashboard, etc.)
- role: Server role (monitoring, ecommerce, webhosting)
- service: Specific service name

Panel Recommendations:
- Service Status Map (all services)
- Server Health Overview (CPU, Memory, Disk)
- Network Traffic (all servers)
- Database Performance (PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
- Security Alerts (Wazuh integration)
- Application Metrics (PrestaShop, Node.js)
- Federation Status (Prometheus federation)
- VPN Connection Status

References:
- SERVERS.md: /home/user/meta-env/SERVERS.md
- Prometheus Config: /home/user/meta-env/monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml
- Network Documentation: Network topology and access methods
